import datetime
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import threading
import time

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CONTROL = ROOT / 'build/stage3-fifth-control'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('fifth_frozen_acceptance', ROOT / 'scripts/acceptance/run.py')
run = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(run)
SCENES = ['first-image', 'preloaded-flip', 'large-dir', 'settle', 'scroll-cached', 'scroll-cold', 'cached-first-screen', 'nas-fault', 'memory-30min']
started = time.monotonic()
status = {'pid': os.getpid(), 'startedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'requestedScenes': SCENES, 'completed': [], 'activeScene': None, 'phase': 'starting'}
scene_runs, exits, monitors = [], [], []
finished = threading.Event()

def snapshot():
    data = dict(status)
    data['updatedAt'] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    data['elapsedSeconds'] = time.monotonic() - started
    if data.get('sceneStartedMonotonic'):
        data['sceneElapsedSeconds'] = time.monotonic() - data['sceneStartedMonotonic']
    if monitors:
        monitor = monitors[-1]
        data['memory'] = {'elapsedSeconds': time.monotonic() - monitor.started,
                          'stateSamples': len(monitor.round_trips), 'stalls': len(monitor.stalls),
                          'maxRoundTripMilliseconds': max(monitor.round_trips, default=None),
                          'stateTimedOut': monitor.timed_out, 'lastState': monitor.last_state}
    temporary = CONTROL / 'progress.pending.json'
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    temporary.replace(CONTROL / 'progress.json')

def heartbeat():
    while not finished.wait(60):
        snapshot()

original_scene = run.run_scene

def run_scene(scene, out, commit, base):
    status.update(activeScene=scene, phase='running', sceneStartedMonotonic=time.monotonic())
    record = {'scene': scene, 'startedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    scene_runs.append(record)
    snapshot()
    print('FIFTH_SCENE_START ' + json.dumps(record), flush=True)
    try:
        return original_scene(scene, out, commit, base)
    finally:
        path = Path(out) / ('S2-T2-' + scene + '.json')
        record.update(endedAt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), elapsedSeconds=time.monotonic() - status['sceneStartedMonotonic'])
        if path.exists():
            document = json.loads(path.read_text())
            record['verdict'] = document['verdict']
        status['completed'] = [dict(item) for item in scene_runs]
        snapshot()

original_stop = run.App.stop

def stop(app):
    pid = app.pid
    result = original_stop(app)
    exits.append({'scene': app.name, 'pid': pid, 'exitCode': app.exit_code, 'normalQuit': app.quit_exited_normally, 'quitSeconds': result, 'socket': app.socket})
    return result

original_monitor_init = run.MemoryStateMonitor.__init__

def monitor_init(monitor, *args, **kwargs):
    original_monitor_init(monitor, *args, **kwargs)
    monitors.append(monitor)

run.run_scene = run_scene
run.App.stop = stop
run.MemoryStateMonitor.__init__ = monitor_init
threading.Thread(target=heartbeat, daemon=True).start()
code = 1
try:
    code = run.main(SCENES + ['--out', str(ROOT / 'docs/reports/bench')])
finally:
    run.stop_live()
    status.update(phase='finished', activeScene=None, returnCode=code)
    finished.set()
    snapshot()
    (CONTROL / 'execution.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scenes': scene_runs, 'appExits': exits, 'returnCode': code}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
raise SystemExit(code)
